description.en: The user risks everything to attack its target. The user faints but does damage equal to its HP.
description.zh_cn: 拼命攻击对手。虽然自己陷入濒死，但会给予对手和自己目前ＨＰ等量的伤害。

description.en: The user passes its held item to the target when the target isn't holding an item.
description.zh_cn: 当对手未携带道具时，能够将自己携带的道具交给对手。

description.en: The user attacks by engulfing the target in an intense fire. This leaves the target with a burn.
description.zh_cn: 用烈焰包裹住对手进行攻击。让对手陷入灼伤状态。

description.en: A column of water strikes the target. When combined with its fire equivalent, its power increases and a rainbow appears.
description.zh_cn: 用水柱进行攻击。如果和火组合，威力就会提高，天空中会挂上彩虹。

description.en: A column of fire hits the target. When used with its grass equivalent, its power increases and a vast sea of fire appears.
description.zh_cn: 用火柱进行攻击。如果和草组合，威力就会提高，周围会变成火海。

description.en: A column of grass hits the target. When used with its water equivalent, its power increases and a vast swamp appears.
description.zh_cn: 用草柱进行攻击。如果和水组合，威力就会提高，周围会变成湿地。

description.en: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
description.zh_cn: 在攻击之后急速返回，和后备宝可梦进行替换。

description.en: While resisting, the user attacks the opposing Pokémon. This lowers the Sp. Atk stat of those hit.
description.zh_cn: 抵抗并攻击对手。降低对手的特攻。

description.en: The user strikes everything around it by stomping down on the ground. This lowers the Speed stat of those hit.
description.zh_cn: 用力踩踏地面并攻击自己周围所有的宝可梦。降低对方的速度。

description.en: The user blows its cold breath on the target. This attack always results in a critical hit.
description.zh_cn: 将冰冷的气息吹向对手进行攻击。必定会击中要害。

description.en: The target is knocked away, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 弹飞对手，强制拉后备宝可梦上场。如果对手为野生宝可梦，战斗将直接结束。

description.en: The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk stats increase.
description.zh_cn: 激励自己，从而提高攻击和特攻。

description.en: The user attacks and captures opposing Pokémon using an electric net. This lowers their Speed stat.
description.zh_cn: 用电网捉住对手进行攻击。降低对手的速度。

description.en: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its target. This also damages the user a little.
description.zh_cn: 让电流覆盖全身撞向对手进行攻击。自己也会受到少许伤害。

description.en: The user crashes into its target while rotating its body like a drill. Critical hits land more easily.
description.zh_cn: 像钢钻一样，一边旋转身体一边撞击对手。容易击中要害。

description.en: The user attacks its target by hitting it with brutal strikes. The target is hit twice in a row.
description.zh_cn: 用身体坚硬的部分拍打对手进行攻击。连续２次给予伤害。

description.en: The user unleashes a vicious blow after its cute act makes the target less wary. This may also make the target flinch.
description.zh_cn: 以可爱的动作使对手疏忽，乘机给出强烈的一击。有时会使对手畏缩。

description.en: The user drains the target's energy with its horns. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.
description.zh_cn: 将角刺入，吸取对手的养分。可以回复给予对手伤害的一半ＨＰ。

description.en: The user attacks by slicing with a long horn. The target's stat changes don't affect this attack's damage.
description.zh_cn: 用长角切斩对手进行攻击。无视对手的能力变化，直接给予伤害。

description.en: The user cuts its target with sharp shells. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.
description.zh_cn: 用锋利的贝壳切斩对手进行攻击。有时会降低对手的防御。

description.en: The user slams its target with its flame-covered body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the move's power.
description.zh_cn: 用燃烧的身体撞向对手进行攻击。自己比对手越重，威力越大。

description.en: The user attacks its target by encircling it in sharp leaves. This attack may also lower the target's accuracy.
description.zh_cn: 用锋利的叶片包裹住对手进行攻击。有时会降低对手的命中率。

description.en: The user crushes its target by rolling over the target with its rolled-up body. This may also make the target flinch.
description.zh_cn: 旋转揉成团的身体压扁对手。有时会使对手畏缩。

description.en: The user protects itself by wrapping its body in soft cotton, which drastically raises the user's Defense stat.
description.zh_cn: 用软绵绵的绒毛包裹住自己的身体进行守护。巨幅提高自己的防御。

description.en: The user lets loose a pitch-black shock wave at its target. This may also lower the target's accuracy.
description.zh_cn: 放出黑暗的冲击波攻击对手。有时会降低对手的命中率。

description.en: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This attack does physical damage.
description.zh_cn: 将神奇的念波实体化攻击对手。给予物理伤害。

description.en: The user attacks by striking the target with its hard tail. It hits the target two to five times in a row.
description.zh_cn: 用坚硬的尾巴拍打对手进行攻击。连续攻击２～５次。

description.en: The user attacks by wrapping its opponent in a fierce wind that flies up into the sky. This may also confuse the target.
description.zh_cn: 用强烈的风席卷对手进行攻击。有时会使对手混乱。

description.en: The user charges its head into its target, using its powerful guard hair. This also damages the user a little.
description.zh_cn: 用厉害的爆炸头猛撞向对手进行攻击。自己也会受到少许伤害。

description.en: The user attacks by throwing steel gears at its target twice.
description.zh_cn: 向对手投掷钢铁齿轮进行攻击。连续２次给予伤害。

description.en: The user torches everything around it in an inferno of scarlet flames. This may also leave those it hits with a burn.
description.zh_cn: 用熊熊烈火攻击自己周围所有的宝可梦。有时会陷入灼伤状态。

description.en: The user fires a beam of light at its target. The move's type changes depending on the Drive the user holds.
description.zh_cn: 向对手放出光弹。属性会根据自己携带的卡带不同而改变。

description.en: The user sings an ancient song and attacks by appealing to the hearts of the listening opposing Pokémon. This may also induce sleep.
description.zh_cn: 让对手听古老之歌，打动对手的内心进行攻击。有时会让对手陷入睡眠状态。

description.en: The user cuts with its long horn. The odd power contained in the horn does physical damage to the target.
description.zh_cn: 用长角切斩对手进行攻击。角上拥有的神奇力量将给予物理伤害。

description.en: The user attacks by blowing freezing cold air at opposing Pokémon. This lowers their Speed stat.
description.zh_cn: 将冰冻的冷气吹向对手进行攻击。会降低对手的速度。

description.en: The user surrounds itself with a great amount of electricity and charges its target. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
description.zh_cn: 让强大的电流覆盖全身，猛撞向对手进行攻击。有时会让对手陷入麻痹状态。

description.en: The user attacks by engulfing the target in an intense, yet beautiful, blue flame. This may also leave the target with a burn.
description.zh_cn: 用美丽而激烈的青焰包裹住对手进行攻击。有时会让对手陷入灼伤状态。

description.en: Cloaked in flames, the user dances and flaps its wings. This may also raise the user's Sp. Atk stat.
description.zh_cn: 让火焰覆盖全身，振翅攻击对手。有时会提高自己的特攻。

description.en: On the second turn, the user hits the target with electrically charged ice. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
description.zh_cn: 用覆盖着电流的冰块，在第２回合撞向对手。有时会让对手陷入麻痹状态。

description.en: On the second turn, an ultracold, freezing wind surrounds the target. This may leave the target with a burn.
description.zh_cn: 用能够冻结一切的强烈冷气，在第２回合包裹住对手。有时会让对手陷入灼伤状态。

description.en: The user yells as if it's ranting about something, which lowers the Sp. Atk stat of opposing Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 没完没了地大声斥责，从而降低对手的特攻。

description.en: The user attacks by harshly dropping large icicles onto the target. This may also make the target flinch.
description.zh_cn: 用大冰柱激烈地撞向对手进行攻击。有时会使对手畏缩。

description.en: With a hot flame on its forehead, the user hurls itself at its target. This lowers the user's Defense, Sp. Def, and Speed stats.
description.zh_cn: 从前额产生灼热的火焰，舍身撞击对手。防御、特防和速度会降低。

description.en: The user brings down a giant flame. This move's power is increased when influenced by an enormous lightning bolt.
description.zh_cn: 释放出巨大的火焰。受到巨大的闪电影响时，招式威力会提高。

description.en: The user throws down a giant lightning bolt. This move's power is increased when influenced by an enormous flame.
description.zh_cn: 释放出巨大的闪电。受到巨大的火焰影响时，招式威力会提高。

description.en: The user dives down onto the target from the sky. This move is Fighting and Flying type simultaneously.
description.zh_cn: 从空中俯冲向对手。此招式同时带有格斗属性和飞行属性。

description.en: Using a pulled-up mat as a shield, the user protects itself and its allies from damaging moves. This does not stop status moves.
description.zh_cn: 将掀起来的榻榻米当作盾牌，防住自己和同伴免受招式伤害。变化招式无法防住。

description.en: The user lets out a damaging belch at the target. The user must eat a held Berry to use this move.
description.zh_cn: 朝着对手打嗝，并给予伤害。如果不吃树果则无法使出。

description.en: Tilling the soil, the user makes it easier for plants to grow. This raises the Attack and Sp. Atk stats of Grass-type Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 翻耕土地，使草木更容易成长。会提高草属性宝可梦的攻击和特攻。

description.en: The user weaves a sticky net around the opposing team, which lowers their Speed stat upon switching into battle.
description.zh_cn: 在对手周围围上黏黏的网，降低替换出场的对手的速度。

description.en: When the user knocks out a target with this move, the user's Attack stat rises drastically.
description.zh_cn: 如果使用此招式打倒对手，攻击会巨幅提高。

description.en: The user vanishes somewhere, then strikes the target on the next turn. This move hits even if the target protects itself.
description.zh_cn: 第１回合消失在某处，第２回合攻击对手。可以无视守护进行攻击。

description.en: The user takes the target trick-or-treating. This adds Ghost type to the target's type.
description.zh_cn: 邀请对手参加万圣夜。使对手被追加幽灵属性。

description.en: Letting out a noble roar, the user intimidates the target and lowers its Attack and Sp. Atk stats.

description.zh_cn: 给自己回复和对手攻击力相同数值的ＨＰ，然后降低对手的攻击。

description.en: In this two-turn attack, the user gathers light and fills a blade with the light's energy, attacking the target on the next turn.
description.zh_cn: 第１回合收集满满的日光，第２回合将此力量集中在剑上进行攻击。

description.en: The user attacks by pelting the target with leaves.
description.zh_cn: 将叶片打向对手，进行攻击。

description.en: The user shines a spotlight on the target so that only the target will be attacked during the turn.
description.zh_cn: 给宝可梦打上聚光灯，该回合只能瞄准该宝可梦。

description.en: The user shoots poisonous threads to poison the target and lower the target's Speed stat.
description.zh_cn: 将混有毒的丝吐向对手。使其中毒，从而降低对手的速度。

description.en: The user concentrates intensely. The attack on the next turn always results in a critical hit.
description.zh_cn: 集中精神，下次攻击必定会击中要害。

description.en: The user engages its gears to raise the Attack and Sp. Atk stats of ally Pokémon with the Plus or Minus Ability.
description.zh_cn: 启动齿轮，提高特性为正电和负电的宝可梦的攻击和特攻。

description.en: The user attacks the target's throat, and the resultant suffering prevents the target from using moves that emit sound for two turns.
description.zh_cn: 受到此招式攻击的对手，会因为地狱般的痛苦，在２回合内，变得无法使出声音类招式。

description.en: The user attacks the enemy with a pollen puff that explodes. If the target is an ally, it gives the ally a pollen puff that restores its HP instead.
description.zh_cn: 对敌人使用是会爆炸的团子。对我方使用则是给予回复的团子。

description.en: The user entangles the target with its anchor chain while attacking. The target becomes unable to flee.
description.zh_cn: 将锚缠住对手进行攻击。使对手无法逃走。

description.en: This protects Pokémon on the ground from priority moves and powers up Psychic-type moves for five turns.
description.zh_cn: 在５回合内，地面上的宝可梦不会受到先制招式的攻击。超能力属性的招式威力会提高。

description.en: The user makes a lunge at the target, attacking with full force. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.
description.zh_cn: 全力猛扑对手进行攻击。从而降低对手的攻击。

description.en: The user strikes the target with a burning lash. This also lowers the target's Defense stat.
description.zh_cn: 用燃烧的鞭子抽打对手。受到攻击的对手防御会降低。

description.en: The user boasts its strength and attacks the target. The more the user's stats are raised, the greater the move's power.
description.zh_cn: 耀武扬威地攻击对手，自己的能力提高得越多，威力就越大。

description.en: To inflict massive damage, the user burns itself out. After using this move, the user will no longer be Fire type.
description.zh_cn: 将自己全身燃烧起火焰来，给予对手大大的伤害。自己的火属性将会消失。

description.en: The user exchanges Speed stats with the target.
description.zh_cn: 将对手和自己的速度进行互换。

description.en: The user stabs the target with a sharp horn. This attack never misses.
description.zh_cn: 用尖尖的角刺入对手进行攻击。攻击必定会命中。

description.en: The user heals the target's status condition. If the move succeeds, it also restores the user's own HP.
description.zh_cn: 治愈对手的异常状态。治愈后可以回复自己的ＨＰ。

description.en: The user attacks the target by dancing very hard. The user's type determines the type of this move.
description.zh_cn: 全力跳舞进行攻击。此招式的属性将变得和自己的属性相同。

description.en: If the Pokémon the user has inflicted damage on have already used their moves, this move eliminates the effect of the target's Ability.
description.zh_cn: 如果给予过伤害的对手已经结束行动，其特性就会被消除。

description.en: The user lands an intense kick of tropical origins on the target. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.
description.zh_cn: 向对手使出来自南国的火热脚踢。从而降低对手的攻击。

description.en: The user instructs the target to use the target's last move again.
description.zh_cn: 向对手下达指示，让其再次使出刚才的招式。

description.en: The user first heats up its beak, and then it attacks the target. Making direct contact with the Pokémon while it's heating up its beak results in a burn.
description.zh_cn: 先加热鸟嘴后再进行攻击。鸟嘴在加热时对手触碰的话，就会使其灼伤。

description.en: The user rubs the scales on its entire body and makes a huge noise to attack the opposing Pokémon. The user's Defense stat goes down after the attack.
description.zh_cn: 摩擦全身鳞片，发出响亮的声音进行攻击。攻击后自己的防御会降低。

description.en: The user uses its body like a hammer to attack the target and inflict damage.
description.zh_cn: 将身体当作锤子，向对手发动袭击，给予伤害。

description.en: The user swings its body around violently to inflict damage on everything in its vicinity.
description.zh_cn: 用自己的身体狂舞挥打，给予对手伤害。

description.en: This move reduces damage from physical and special moves for five turns. This can be used only in a hailstorm.
description.zh_cn: 在５回合内减弱物理和特殊的伤害。只有冰雹时才能使出。

description.en: The user, Decidueye, creates countless arrows using its Z-Power and shoots the target with full force.
description.zh_cn: 通过Ｚ力量制造出无数箭的狙射树枭将全力射穿对手进行攻击。

description.en: The user, Incineroar, strengthens its body using its Z-Power and crashes into the target with full force.
description.zh_cn: 通过Ｚ力量得到强壮肉体的炽焰咆哮虎将全力撞向对手进行攻击。

description.en: The user, Primarina, summons a massive amount of  water using its Z-Power and attacks the target with  full force.
description.zh_cn: 通过Ｚ力量召唤大量水的西狮海壬将全力攻击对手。

description.en: The user, the Land Spirit Pokémon, obtains Alola's energy using its Z-Power and attacks the target with full force. This reduces the target's HP greatly.
description.zh_cn: 通过Ｚ力量得到阿罗拉之力的土地神宝可梦将全力进行攻击。对手的剩余ＨＰ会减少很多。

description.en: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Marshadow, punches and kicks the target consecutively with full force.
description.zh_cn: 得到Ｚ力量的玛夏多将全力使出拳头和脚踢的连续招式叩打对手。

description.en: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Alolan Raichu, attacks the target with full force. This move leaves the target with paralysis.
description.zh_cn: 得到Ｚ力量的阿罗拉地区的雷丘将全力进行攻击。从而让对手陷入麻痹状态。

description.en: Z-Power brings out the true capabilities of the user, Snorlax. The Pokémon moves its enormous body energetically and attacks the target with full force.
description.zh_cn: 通过Ｚ力量使得认真起来的卡比兽跃动巨大身躯，全力向对手发动袭击。

description.en: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Eevee, gets energy from its evolved friends and boosts its stats sharply.
description.zh_cn: 得到Ｚ力量的伊布将借助进化后伙伴们的力量，大幅提高能力。

description.en: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Mew, attacks the target with full force. The terrain will be charged with psychic energy.
description.zh_cn: 得到Ｚ力量的梦幻将全力攻击对手。脚下会变成精神场地。

description.en: The user sets a shell trap. If the user is hit by a physical move, the trap will explode and inflict damage on the opposing Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 设下甲壳陷阱。如果对手使出物理招式，陷阱就会爆炸并给予对手伤害。

description.en: The user unleashes a strong beam. The attack's recoil harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.
description.zh_cn: 放出强力光束后，自己的特攻会大幅降低。

description.en: The user bites the target with its psychic capabilities. This can also destroy Light Screen and Reflect.
description.zh_cn: 利用精神力量咬住对手进行攻击。还可以破坏光墙和反射壁等。

description.en: Driven by frustration, the user attacks the target. If the user's previous move has failed, the power of this move doubles.
description.zh_cn: 化悔恨为力量进行攻击。如果上一回合招式没有打中，威力就会翻倍。

description.en: The user attacks by beating the target with a bone that contains a spirit. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.
description.zh_cn: 用附有灵魂的骨头殴打对手进行攻击。有时会降低对手的防御。

description.en: The user smashes into the target at high speed. This move always goes first.
description.zh_cn: 迅速撞向对手进行攻击。必定能够先制攻击。

description.en: The user slams into the target using a full-force blast of water. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.
description.zh_cn: 用水之力量撞向对手进行攻击。有时会降低对手的防御。

description.en: The user shoots powerful lasers using the power of a prism. The user can't move on the next turn.
description.zh_cn: 用棱镜的力量发射强烈光线。下一回合自己将无法动弹。

description.en: The user hides in the target's shadow, steals the target's stat boosts, and then attacks.
description.zh_cn: 潜入对手的影子进行攻击。会夺取对手的能力提升。

description.en: The user slams into the target with the force of a meteor. This move can be used on the target  regardless of its Abilities.
description.zh_cn: 以流星般的气势猛撞对手。可以无视对手的特性进行攻击。

description.en: The user emits a sinister ray to attack the target. This move can be used on the target regardless of  its Abilities.
description.zh_cn: 放出奇怪的光线攻击对手。可以无视对手的特性进行攻击。

description.en: The user gets teary eyed to make the target lose its combative spirit. This lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats.
description.zh_cn: 变得泪眼汪汪，让对手丧失斗志。从而降低对手的攻击和特攻。

description.en: A strong electric blast crashes down on the target, giving it an electric shock. This may also make the target flinch.
description.zh_cn: 撞向对手，并发出强电，使其感到麻麻刺刺的。有时会使对手畏缩。

description.en: The user hits the target with the force of nature. It halves the target's HP.
description.zh_cn: 向对手释放自然之怒。对手的ＨＰ会减半。

description.en: Cloaking itself in high energy, the user slams into the target. The memory held determines the move's type.
description.zh_cn: 一边覆盖高能量，一边撞向对手进行攻击。根据存储碟不同，属性会改变。

description.en: The user, Pikachu wearing a cap, powers up a jolt of electricity using its Z-Power and unleashes it. Critical hits land more easily.
description.zh_cn: 戴着帽子的皮卡丘将通过Ｚ力量增强的电击全力释放给对手。容易击中要害。

description.en: The user attacks everything around it by causing its own head to explode. This also damages the user.
description.zh_cn: 让自己的头爆炸，来攻击周围的一切。自己也会受到伤害。

description.en: The user attacks with electrically charged fists. This move changes Normal-type moves to Electric-type moves.
description.zh_cn: 用覆盖着电流的拳头进行攻击。使一般属性的招式变成电属性。

description.en: The user attacks a target with a pillar of light. This move inflicts Attack or Sp. Atk damage—whichever stat is higher for the user.
description.zh_cn: 用光柱来进行攻击。比较自己的攻击和特攻，用数值相对较高的一项给予对方伤害。

description.en: This attack inflicts Attack or Sp. Atk damage— whichever stat is higher for the user, Necrozma.  This move ignores the target's Ability.
description.zh_cn: 奈克洛兹玛会无视对手的特性效果，在攻击和特攻之间，用数值相对较高的一项给予对方伤害。

description.en: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Solgaleo, attacks the target with full force. This move can ignore the effect of the target's Ability.
description.zh_cn: 得到Ｚ力量的索尔迦雷欧将全力进行攻击。可以无视对手的特性效果。

description.en: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Lunala, attacks the target with full force. This move can ignore the effect of the target's Ability.
description.zh_cn: 得到Ｚ力量的露奈雅拉将全力进行攻击。可以无视对手的特性效果。

description.en: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Mimikyu, punches the target with full force.
description.zh_cn: 得到Ｚ力量的谜拟Ｑ将全力进行乱揍攻击。

description.en: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Lycanroc, attacks the target with full force. This move negates the effect on the battlefield.
description.zh_cn: 得到Ｚ力量的鬃岩狼人将全力进行攻击。而且会消除场地状态。

description.en: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Kommo-o, attacks the opposing Pokémon with full force. This move boosts the user's stats.
description.zh_cn: 得到Ｚ力量的杖尾鳞甲龙将全力攻击对手。并且自己的能力会提高。
